summary_en: ToSTNeT-3 buyback block settlement: purchase price fixed at ¥1,100/share. Block size 2,500 shares (0.4% of shares outstanding), aggregate value ¥2.75 million. Settlement per separate authorization notice issued same date.
title_en: Notice of Confirmation of Purchase Price for Treasury Stock Acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 Off-Hours Trading
translation_en_brief: Kanro Inc. (ticker 2216) announced on 31 July 2026 that the purchase price for a block of treasury shares acquired via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading has been fixed at ¥1,100 per share, effective today's close. The block comprises 2,500 shares (0.4% of shares outstanding excluding treasury), with an aggregate acquisition value of ¥2.75 million. This price confirmation follows a separate authorization notice issued on the same date covering the authorization and terms of both the direct acquisition and the ToSTNeT-3 trading mechanism, as well as related treasury-share cancellation resolutions.
